reason: At app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22-26, `limit` and `offset` come straight from `params` via `.to_i` and go into `.limit(limit).offset(offset)` without being clamped. Negative values reach Postgres, which rejects them ('LIMIT/OFFSET must not be negative') and the request returns a 500. There is also no upper cap, so a request with a huge `limit` returns all members.
